Spacecraft name SWITCH (Stratospheric Water Inventory, Tomography of Convective Hydration)
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 6U
Status cancelled
Entity name NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory
Institution Space agency
Entity Government (Civil / Military)
Nation US
Oneliner

Measure water vapor in the upper troposphere and lower stratosphere with microwave sensor.
Description

Revolutionary approach for making high resolution measurements of atmospheric composition. The technique uses a transmitter and receiver to produce an “active microwave tomographic” capability that will measure water vapor in the upper troposphere and lower stratosphere, along with other species, to a 500m vertical resolution.
